note: TC-01/02/04/05/06/07/08/09 use fresh real CLI processes. Direct authorization, ownership and storage failures use the recorded executed C++ tests. TC-12 combines local execution with prior cross-platform CI evidence; Linux was not run on this Windows laptop.

results.observed: Valid accounts persisted; repeating alex was rejected without changing the accounts file.
Wrong name/password used the same failure; valid login succeeded; three same-password accounts had distinct salts and no plaintext password.
Executed direct-service authorization unit test passed; learner CLI displayed no administrator menu.
Empty question prompt and unknown quiz reference were rejected; valid three-question fixture reloaded after process restart.
Quiz listed with three questions; each was displayed once; A,C,B produced a saved 3/3 result.
X repeated question 1; the valid A advanced it; subsequent questions were displayed once.
A,D,B against A,C,B produced exactly one completed attempt, 2/3 and 66.7%.
Separate learner logins returned only the respective 3/3 or 2/3 result; direct ownership-denial test passed.
Administrator saw both named learners; unit tests denied learner, guest, and logged-out sessions.
Recorded executed unit tests preserve committed files after injected write failure and reject malformed account/attempt records.
40 samples per operation at the planned volume: menu p95 445.705 ms; question p95 0.0187 ms; both <= 2000 ms.

Local Windows instrumented build and real CLI smoke passed. Previously completed main CI at the recorded source base passed Windows and Linux: https://github.com/Team14OnlineQuiz/Online_quiz_system/actions/runs/44013570777
